segments.name: Fitness Equipment
segments.description: Markets and sells home and commercial fitness equipment directly to retail and commercial customers through online and offline channels.
segments.evidence: In our fitness equipment business segment, we sell our products directly to customers through online or offline platforms.

segments.name: Licensing
segments.description: Offers a turnkey licensing solution for personal training studios and commercial gym chains, outfitting facilities with proprietary equipment and services.
segments.evidence: We offer a turnkey solution for personal training studios and commercial gym chains.

revenueModel.text: The company earns revenue from direct sales of fitness equipment to retail and commercial customers, plus annual license fees from licensees of a base fee plus a fee per opened fitness center.
revenueModel.evidence: Fees payable by our licensee to us are a base fee per annum of $125,000 plus $40,000 for each opened fitness center per annum.

changes.text: In 2021, the company launched its licensing business with mYSTEPS Training Clinic as its first licensee.
changes.evidence: we launched our licensing business in late 2021. mYSTEPS Training Clinic, a new concept fitness club chain, is our first licensee

changes.text: In 2025, the company began a Solana cryptocurrency treasury program using financing proceeds.
changes.evidence: On September 24, 2025, the Company announced its first strategic purchase under the Company's SOL treasury initiative following the first closing under the Company's $100 million facility.
